senses.gloss:
Fat,Ⓒa.ⒹpIna, pIvara, puzwa, mAMsala, ApyAna, sTUla, sPIta; medasvin, puzwAMga (gI f.), sTUladeha; ‘f(at) land’ urvarA.
Ⓔs.Ⓓmedas n., vasA(SA), vapA, mAMsasAraH-snehaH.
Ⓝ[Fat]ten,Ⓒv. t.ⒹA-pyE v., sPAy c. (sPAvayati), saM-vfD c., pIvarIkf 8 U, paripuz c.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹApyE 1 A, pInIBU, saMvfD 1 A, sPAy 1 A, upabfMh 1 P.
Ⓝ[Fat]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹmedasvitA, pInatA, [] sTUlatA, medovfdDi f., sPIti f.
Ⓝ[Fat]ty,Ⓒa.ⒹmAMsala, medasvin.

Fate,Ⓒs.ⒹdEvaM, BAgyaM, BAgaDeyaM, dizwaM, adfzwaM, karman n., niyati f., prAktanaM, BavitavyatA; ‘personified f(ate)’ viDiH, viDAtA, kftAMtaH, kAlaH; ‘it is our f(ate) to do wrong’ pApAcaraRaM dEvAyattaM-dEvADInaM.
Ⓑ
 2 mftyuH, nASaH, kzayaH, aMtaH; gati f., pariRAmaH; ‘he met with a sad f(ate)’ SocanIyaH-kazwaH-tasya aMtaH samajAyata; ‘what was Sītāʼs f(ate)’ sItAdevyAH kiM vfttaM (U. 2); ‘such has been the f(ate) of your birth’ IdfSaste nirmARaBAgaH pariRataH (U. 4); ‘ill-f(ate)’ durdEvaM, maMdaBAgyaM, dEvadurvipAkaH-viparyayaH-viparyAsaH.
Ⓝ[Fat]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓniyata, dEvaniyukta, nirdizwa, Bavitavya; ‘whose f(ated) time has come’ prAptakAlaH; ‘ill-f(ated)’ dEvopahata, durdEva, maMdaBAgya; ‘well-f(ated)’ BAgyavat, Danya, sasOBAgya.
ⓃFatal,Ⓒa.ⒹprARahara, prARanASaka, jIvitApaha, aMtakara, prARaGAtin, mftyujanaka, durvipAka, marmaBedin.
Ⓑ
 2 dEva (vI f.), niyata, dEvayukta, AvaSyaka (kI f.).
Ⓝ[Fatal]ism,Ⓒs.ⒹdEvaparatA, dEvADInatA.
Ⓝ[Fatal]ist,Ⓒs.ⒹdEvaparaH, dEvAyattaH, dEvaparAyaRaH, dEvADInaH, yadBavizyaH, dEvapramARakaH.
Ⓝ[Fatal]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹprARaharatvaM; niyatiH, BavitavyatA, avaSyakatvaM.
Ⓝ[Fatal]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹsanASaM, prARAMtikaM, ‘f(atally) wounded’ taTA kzato yaTA'saMdigDo mftyuH.

Father,Ⓒs.Ⓓpitf m., janakaH, janitf-janayitf m., janmadaH, tAtaH; ‘f(ather) and mother’ pitarO, mAtApitarO, mAtarapitarO.
Ⓑ
 2 guruH, pUjyaH; ‘f(ather)-in-law’ SvaSuraH; ‘f(ather)land’ janma-pEtfka-BUmi f.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹsvIkf 8 U, parigrah 9 P.
Ⓑ
 2 A-ruh c. (ropayati), niviS c., (with loc.).
Ⓝ[Father]hood,Ⓒs.ⒹpitfBAvaH-DarmaH, pitftvaM.
Ⓝ[Father]less,Ⓒa.Ⓓapitfka, tAta-pitf-hIna, anATa.
Ⓝ[Father]ly,Ⓒa.ⒹtAta-pitf-tulyaM, pitfnirviSeza; gen. by comp.; ‘f(atherly) affection’ pitf-vAtsalyaM.
Ⓔadv.Ⓓpitfvat, tAtarUpeRa.

Fathom,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓ(talaM or veDaM) parIkz 1 A, nirUp 10, mA 3 A or c. (mApayati), vyaD 4 P; ‘f(athom) anotherʼs thoughts’ manaH parIkz or gAh 1 A or nirUp.
Ⓔs.ⒹvyAmaH, vyAyAmaH.
Ⓝ[Fathom]less,Ⓒa.ⒹagADa, atalasparSa, anavagAhya, agamyatala.

Fatigue,Ⓒs.ⒹAyAsaH, klamaH, SramaH, avasAdaH, KedaH, pariSramaH, kleSaH, glAni-klAMti-SrAMti f., taMdrA, ‘inured to f(atigue)’ SramasahizRu, jitaSrama.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹKid c., Ayas c., avasad c., klam c. or Sram c. (kla-Sra-mayati), kliS 9 P, glE c. (gla-glA-payati).
Ⓝ[Fatigu]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹSrAMta, klAMta, Kinna, glAna, avasanna, SramArta, saSrama, jAtaKeda-Srama; ‘to be f(atigued)’ Sram 4 P, klam 1, 4 P, Ayas 1, 4 P, Kid pass.
